questions.question: If someone says they have fellowship with God but walk in the darkness, what does that make them?

answers.text: They lie and do not practice the truth
They lose the joy they were given
They are cut off and cannot return

questions.question: If we walk in the light as God is in the light, what cleanses us from all sin?

answers.text: The blood of Jesus His Son
The water of the Jordan River
The ashes of a red heifer

questions.question: The New Testament says that if anyone sins, who is our advocate before the Father?
Jesus is the atoning sacrifice for the sins of the writer and his companions. Whose sins does it also cover?
